## Feature Type

- [ ] New Icon Request
- [ ] New Feature/Enhancement

## Description

A clear and concise description of the feature or icon you'd like to see.

## Use Case

Describe the problem or use case this feature/icon would solve.

## Icon Details (if requesting new icon)

- **Icon Name**: [e.g., shopping-cart-filled]
- **Category**: [e.g., Commerce & Shopping]
- **Variant**: [ ] Outline [ ] Filled [ ] Both
- **Similar Icons**: [Reference similar existing icons or provide inspiration links]

## Mockup or Reference

If you have a visual reference or mockup, please attach it here.

## Additional Context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
